description.text: A starter deck built around Typhlosion ex, released on 5 March 2005 together with Meganium ex and Feraligatr ex decks for the other two Johto starters. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
